hero.summary: A documentation page examining how critique, self-assessment, and design evaluation shaped the development of Envue’s brand identity system.

video.label: Video Synopsis
video.title: Collaboration Overview
video.description: A synopsis explaining how critique and self-assessment informed revisions to Envue’s strategy, visual identity, typography, and system design.

overview.title: Evaluation Framework
overview.body: Collaboration for Envue was documented through a combination of feedback review and self-assessment. Each entry explains the design concern, evaluates the value of the critique or assessment, identifies the source used to validate the decision, and describes how the resulting revision improved the brand identity system.

steps.title: Feedback or Self-Assessment
steps.body: A critique, observation, or design concern identified during Envue’s development.

steps.title: Evaluation
steps.body: The reasoning process used to determine whether the critique or concern improved the broader brand identity.

steps.title: Revision Outcome
steps.body: The resulting change to typography, layout, visual hierarchy, messaging, or system consistency.

collaboration.title: Feedback + Self-Assessment Entries
collaboration.intro: The following entries document how critique and self-assessment shaped Envue’s development. Each entry connects a design concern to a validated revision and explains how the change improved clarity, cohesion, flexibility, or emotional alignment.
